# the same query, but the socket of K3s is looked up in the process list at every call and ctr is configured with CONTAINERD_ADDRESS / CONTAINERD_NAMESPACE
mkdir -p /tmp/bench73941545
cat > /tmp/bench73941545/lookup.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
SOCK=$(pgrep -ax containerd | sed -n 's/.* -a \([^ ]*\).*/\1/p' | head -1)
[ -S "$SOCK" ] || { echo "the K3s containerd was not found" >&2; exit 1; }
export CONTAINERD_ADDRESS=$SOCK CONTAINERD_NAMESPACE=k8s.io
case "$1" in
    image)
        d=$(ctr images ls 2>/dev/null | awk -v r="$2" '$1 == r { print $3; exit }')
        [ -n "$d" ] || exit 1
        echo "$d"
        ;;
    container)
        ctr containers ls -q 2>/dev/null | grep -qxF -- "$2" || exit 1
        ctr tasks ls 2>/dev/null | awk -v c="$2" '$1 == c && $3 == "RUNNING" { f = 1 } END { print (f ? "running" : "stopped") }'
        ;;
    *) exit 2 ;;
esac
EOF
sudo bash /tmp/bench73941545/lookup.sh image bench73941545.local/app:1
CID=$(sudo crictl --runtime-endpoint unix:///run/bench73941545/k3s/containerd/containerd.sock --image-endpoint unix:///run/bench73941545/k3s/containerd/containerd.sock ps -q --name '^bench73941545-app$')
sudo bash /tmp/bench73941545/lookup.sh container "$CID"

#!/bin/bash
ask() {   # $1 = socket, $2 = namespace
    ctr -a "$1" -n "$2" images ls 2>/dev/null | awk -v r="$IMG" '$1 == r { print $3; exit }'
}
D=/run/bench73941545/containerd/containerd.sock
K=/run/bench73941545/k3s/containerd/containerd.sock
case "$1" in
    image)
        IMG=$2
        d=$(ask $D default); [ -n "$d" ] || d=$(ask $D k8s.io); [ -n "$d" ] || d=$(ask $K k8s.io)
        [ -n "$d" ] || exit 1
        echo "$d"
        ;;
    container)
        for s in $D $K; do
            if ctr -a $s -n k8s.io containers ls -q 2>/dev/null | grep -qxF -- "$2"; then
                if [ "$(ctr -a $s -n k8s.io tasks ls 2>/dev/null | awk -v c="$2" '$1 == c { print $3 }')" = RUNNING ]; then echo running; else echo stopped; fi
                exit 0
            fi
        done
        exit 1
        ;;
    *) exit 2 ;;
esac
EOF
